basics.name: Roland Sharp
basics.label: Agentic Engineer (Remote)
basics.summary: Agentic engineer. I build software by directing AI coding agents: I set the architecture, write the specs and tests that keep the agents honest, review every diff, and debug what they get wrong. This year I've shipped terminal tools with 180+ GitHub stars: a CRT oscilloscope in Nim (108★), sshmail, an encrypted messaging hub for AI agents (41★, live at sshmail.dev), and a terminal tarot reader with local-LLM readings (30★). Also building aitherLang, a live-coded audio language that compiles to native code in milliseconds. Before agents, 5+ years shipping production Node.js/TypeScript backends for exchanges and blockchain companies. Co-founder of JSON Resume (4.2K GitHub stars).

work.summary: Designing and shipping open-source tools with Claude Code as the implementation partner: I own the architecture, the evaluation and the decisions; the agent writes most of the code, and I read and test all of it. terminal-oscilloscope (108★): CRT phosphor oscilloscope for the terminal in Nim, 200 KB binary, live audio capture on its own thread. sshmail (41★, 5 forks): encrypted messaging hub over SSH for humans and AI agents, in Go, with SSH-key identity, a TUI served over SSH and a JSON API; deployed at sshmail.dev. tarot (30★): terminal tarot reader in Go with pixel-art cards and readings from a local LLM via Ollama. aitherLang: a language for real-time audio in Nim; patches transpile to C, compile in-process with TCC in milliseconds and hot-reload without losing state, and a background cc -O2 rebuild makes heavy patches up to 5x cheaper. Diagnosed a code-generation bug where nested filter calls corrupted each other's state, fixed it, and pinned it with sample-exact regression tests. Research: Resonance, a neural network built from the damped harmonic oscillator equation, entered in OpenAI's Parameter Golf challenge.
Built the TypeScript client SDK and public data API for a decentralized exchange. Complex aggregate SQL queries, Ethereum and Cosmos JavaScript APIs, AWS Lambda deployment.

Maintained and built out the API gateway for an Australian cryptocurrency exchange. Built the initial market-starting arbitrage bot. TypeScript, GraphQL, TypeORM, Redis, JWT and TOTP multi-factor authentication.

Built a zero-knowledge query service for a consortium blockchain — the first company to use Hyperledger in production. Homomorphic encryption, private blockchain for immutable audit logs. 15+ Docker containers orchestrated with Docker Compose.
Built the server for laplateforme.com, France's largest building construction hardware retailer. Mentored PHP developers on modern JavaScript. Node.js, Express.js, Mocha.js, MySQL.
Built the main REST API for beacon location tracking on Android devices. Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Mongoose.
Geo-monitoring applications using Node.js. Built modules for meteorological and geological data processing. Maintained 500+ end-to-end and unit tests.

Co-founded the open-source initiative to create a JSON-based standard for resumes. Built the original CLI tool and registry server. 4.2K GitHub stars. The standard is still actively maintained and widely used.

references.name: Thomas Davis
references.reference: I've known Roland for many years, and had the privilege of working closely with him at Blockbid, an Australian crypto currency exchange. Together we built out an API gateway which fronted a distributed system with Kubenetes on AWS. We used Open API v3 to define a schema for our public facing API, we built a custom schema validator which filtered out unexpected requests and responses improving security and consistency. We used JWT's to authenticate users on different microservices by passing them around with associated jobs in RabbitMQ. On top of this we managed to also support GraphQL and namely our own Apollo client frontend. He is excellent at Javascript/Typescript, writes readable, terse, documented and modular code.
